_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Giocatô inta 'n {width}x{height} grìggia.
Ti sei 'n giocatô {player_id}. Möi validi: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' ò w/s/a/d.
Obietîvo: sopravivî a tutti âtri. E tracce sòn letæ; i impatti co-e pareti amazan; i scontrî testa-a-testa amazan tutti dui.

board.after_moves: A tabella dòppo de mosse simultanee: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: O zugatô {player_id} o l'é mòrto pe unna mossa no valida.

outcome.survived_win: O zugatô {player_id} o l'é rescivæu; tutti i atri se son schiantæ.
outcome.all_crashed: Tutti i zugadô an fæto a cascia insemme.
outcome.turn_limit: O limite de rotaçion o l'é arrivou: vinse chi ciù longhessa a vitta.
